_comment: Hooks for django-plugin. PostToolUse: format the changed Python file with ruff, run through sdlc/hooks/run-tool.sh (local ruff first, then a running Docker Compose service, skipped silently when neither has it or the project has no Python markers). PreToolUse: config protection. SubagentStop: batched `ruff check .` after the architect, resolved the same way.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -j '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.stdout.write(json.load(sys.stdin)["tool_input"]["file_path"])' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py) s=$(bash -c 'n=run-tool.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; printf %s "$s"'); [ -n "$s" ] || exit 0; bash "$s" --lang python --quiet -- ruff format "$f"; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 'n=config-protection.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" 'ruff.toml' '.ruff.toml' 'pyproject.toml' 'setup.cfg' '.editorconfig'; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Protect this stack's tooling config (ruff.toml;.ruff.toml;pyproject.toml;setup.cfg;.editorconfig) from being edited mid-run to make a diff pass. Denies only while an sdlc run state file is fresh and task_type is not chore; silent otherwise.

hooks.command: bash -c 'n=post-implement-check.sh; r="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; bs=\\; r="${r//"$bs"//}"; s=""; if [ -n "$r" ]; then for c in "$r/../sdlc/hooks/$n" "$r/../../sdlc/${r##*/}/hooks/$n" "$r"/../../sdlc/*/hooks/"$n"; do if [ -f "$c" ] && [ ! -e "${c%/hooks/*}/.orphaned_at" ]; then s="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$s" ] && [ -f "${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n" ]; then s="${PWD}/plugins/sdlc/hooks/$n"; fi; if [ -n "$s" ]; then exec bash "$s" --lang python -- ruff check .; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Batched post-implement check: runs `ruff check .` once after this stack's architect finishes and relays failures to the orchestrator as a retry hint. Resolved through hooks/_runner-lib.sh: local install first, then a running compose service; silent when python does not apply to the project, the tool is absent in both places, or no run is active.
